lines.name: Boulevard Line
lines.beyond: south to Southside: through-running; second terminus and depot off-sheet

lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north along Harbour Road past Crown Road; south along Sunset Way past Comet Row. Termini and depot are off-sheet and not planned here

lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Not run through the checker: I have no shell here. Next owner runs `bun tools/plan/cli.ts` and sends back the output. Geometry assumes road space is each road's width rectangle with no end caps, and that T-C1 is tested on both track centres (±1.8 m). T1 and S1 are listed again unchanged, only to state `order` for N-O1.

Tide's two-way Sky Loop on the ring is not proposed. At ring corners an r≥70 curve bulges about 29 m inward from the centreline against a 12 m half-width, so it passes over corner plots (S-C1). It also duplicates S1. This conflicts with the plan concept note (S1 is one straight trunk). Retiring the loops is still an open question for Sky.

T1 is kept terminating on the circus balloon, not running through the circus as tide's draft has it. If it ran up Crown Avenue, Crown Road has no room for a loop (T-L1). So it would have to turn onto Crown Road on the east carriageway (x≈5, y≈289) and run off-sheet, and nothing in the plan says where to. Sky's open question decides this.

T2 Harbour Line is new. It runs from Harbour Road (north sheet edge) down to Market Street, west along it, then south on Sunset Way to the sheet edge. Reason: on current lines these plots are beyond reach 250: harbour-east (278 m from Harbour sta, 285 from Records stop), docks-east, rocket-west (272) and lantern-west (289). Both ends leave the sheet, so no loops are needed.

Track positions keep the r50 corners inside street space. On Harbour Road the tracks run on the east carriageway (x 308). Market Street runs slightly diagonal from y -414 to -404 across its median. On Sunset Way the tracks run on the west carriageway (x -347). An r50 curve centred on road centrelines would cut about 2 m into the corner plots.

Interchanges: T2/T1 at Market St × Boulevard is about 30 m from the Records stop (0,-380). T2/S1 on Harbour Road at y 0 is about 32 m from Harbour station (340,0). T2 crosses T1 on the level in the Boulevard reservation. No standard covers flat crossings, so Splice/Keel should confirm. The concept note 'one interchange' needs updating (Aster).

Mission impact for Waymark: T2 passes the Records Precinct gates at Rocket Lane (-186,-410) and Satellite Street (-60,-410). A stop there would put a station-seal point right at the gates. Vantage should not place stops there until Waymark decides.
